channel.title: AI Legal — Essays & research
channel.description: Independent writing on AI, law and governance. Published by AILL LLC, doing business as AI Legal.

item.title: The Compliance Surface
item.description: The EU AI Act is not stalling enterprise deals through its substance. It is stalling them through its surface — the questionnaire that arrives three steps before the contract.

item.title: Information, Not Advice
item.description: Every useful piece of legal software lives on a line it must not cross. Designing for that line — rather than pretending it is not there — is the whole craft.

item.title: After the Omnibus
item.description: A delay to the high-risk deadlines is not a reprieve. It is a redistribution — of pressure, of attention, and of where the real obligations now sit.

item.title: The Pattern Between Industries
item.description: The same compliance problem keeps appearing in law, health, insurance and finance wearing different clothes. Seeing through the costume is a kind of asset.
